description: This file contains the implementation of the ShellSettingsManager class, which manages loading, saving, and removing shell settings and configurations for tenants in OrchardCore. It handles configuration sources, concurrency control, and interacts with configuration providers and sources.

classes.name: ShellSettingsManager
classes.description: Manages tenant shell settings including loading, saving, and removing configurations, with concurrency control and configuration source management.

methods.name: CreateDefaultSettings
methods.description: Creates default shell settings based on current configuration.

methods.name: LoadSettingsNamesAsync
methods.description: Loads the names of all configured tenants asynchronously.

methods.name: LoadSettingsAsync
methods.description: Loads specific tenant shell settings asynchronously by tenant name.

methods.name: SaveSettingsAsync
methods.description: Saves the provided shell settings asynchronously.

methods.name: EnsureConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Ensures the configuration is initialized, building configuration sources if necessary.

methods.name: ReloadTenantsSettingsAsync
methods.description: Reloads tenant settings from configuration sources asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources used by the ShellSettingsManager.
